maddeler.e:
تقلعفون (form IVq)
# تَقْلَعِفُّونَ (taqlaʕiffūna) /taq.la.ʕif.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# تُقْلَعَفُّونَ (tuqlaʕaffūna) /tuq.la.ʕaf.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
